question: Identify the antonym of "Glut":
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Glut"** means an excessive supply of something or an overabundance. (अधिकता)
 
 
• **Example:** The market experienced a glut of cheap products, which caused prices to plummet.
 
 
• The word **"Starve"** is the antonym of "Glut" as it refers to suffering or dying from a lack of food or resources, which is the opposite of excess. (भूखा रहना)
 
 
• **Example:** The drought caused crops to fail, leaving many families to starve.
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of "Glut" is **"Starve."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Overload** (अधिभार): To load something excessively.
 
 
• **Example:** The truck was overloaded with goods, making it unsafe to drive.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Satiate** (तृप्त करना): To satisfy completely or to the fullest extent.
 
 
• **Example:** The feast was enough to satiate even the hungriest of guests.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Stuff** (भरना): To fill something tightly or cram.
 
 
• **Example:** She stuffed her backpack with books before heading to school.
